notes: The Vila de Gràcia neighbourhood council meets at least twice a year, and any resident can take part. [1]
The Gràcia district directory lists the Asociación de Vecinos y Comerciantes de la Plaza Lesseps. [2]
The same directory lists the Castellers de la Vila de Gràcia, at Carrer de l'Alzina 7. [2]
Gràcia has causes, esplais, neighbourhood associations, cultural ateneos, consumer cooperatives and other groups. Source is undated and about 1,189 days old, so treat as dated. [3]
Older Gràcia buildings often keep a porter, and participation in residents' meetings (juntas) is high. Published 2026-03-01. [4]
Community group or hashtag for sourdough buyers in Gràcia: not found in the search results.
Festival Drap-Art Barcelona runs from 17 November to 21 December 2026. Not a food event; listed only as context. [5]
Barcelona's Pa de Pagès is listed at 3–6 €, and special ancient-grain breads reach 7–8 €; the ranking is dated 2025. [6]
Origo Bakery has a Gràcia shop, open 08:00–20:30 on weekdays and 08:00–19:00 on weekends and holidays. Page undated. [7]
The Fira de Nadal de la Sagrada Família runs from 21 November to 23 December 2026 in the basilica square. [8]
Santa Llúcia runs from 27 November to 23 December, 10:00–21:00, with more than 160 stalls. Conflict: one source gives 28 November as the opening date. and [8][9]
Barcelona turns on its Christmas lights on Thursday 26 November on Passeig de Gràcia. [10]
The FAD's Disseny Market is free and runs 11–13 and 18–20 December. [10]
Mostaza Fest, a local design and craft fair, runs 5–6 December 2026. [9]
Supermarket bake-off or in-store bread promotion tactics in Barcelona: not found.
